Therefore equal MK_STATS bytes_peak is expected and cannot measure ArrayList backing-buffer memory. The max RSS comparison from /usr/bin/time -lp does include those buffers. Candidate MK_STATS counts were captured from executables linked to each variant object; the object hashes match the O3 build records.
